answer: Audits are published in yarrow, queued in tide, and wharf publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 72 identities per epoch. A farm of 400 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2734 identities would post 3358 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
